summary: Module responsibilities are clearly defined with logical separation of inventory, environment, and quest concerns. Code follows Unreal patterns with proper module registration and state management, though some redundancy exists in logging. Integration is functional: chest opens and adds items, campfire lighting triggers quests, and logs confirm cause-effect chains. However, object name usage as item names may be semantically weak, and EnemyGuard does not fully integrate with a battle system despite being flagged. Runtime logs verify core flows but lack edge-case validation.
